children: Overview
US water utility's Q3 revenue rose 6.7% yr/yr
Q3 diluted EPS rose to $1.05 from $1.03 a year earlier
Revenue growth driven by rate changes, new customers, and regulatory approvals, partly offset by lower usage
Outlook
Company expects to close Nevada and Oregon acquisitions in Q4 2026
Company expects to invest $228 mln in PFAS treatment and well replacement projects
Company says it has resources to finance ongoing initiatives into H1 2027
Result Drivers
RATE CHANGES AND NEW CUSTOMERS - Co said Q3 revenue growth was driven by rate changes and new customers
LOWER USAGE - Co said decline in customer water usage offset revenue increases
REGULATORY APPROVALS - Co said regulatory approvals in Washington contributed to revenue growth
